messages.subject: Views in dbExists
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

is there a reason why views are not considered when using dbExistsTable? Is 
this something what can be added? Basically we need only to replace 
pg_tables with information_schema.tables (and do some column names fixes).

Regards,

Tomas
